spec.title: DashboardFlask
spec.summary: A Flask-based interactive dashboard that renders data visualizations using HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript, with dynamic endpoints serving JSON to populate charts.

files.name: app.py
files.purpose: Main Flask application defining routes and serving dashboard

files.name: templates/base.html
files.purpose: Base HTML template with Bootstrap and container for dashboard

files.name: static/css/style.css
files.purpose: Custom CSS styles for dashboard layout

files.name: static/js/dashboard.js
files.purpose: JavaScript fetching data from API and rendering Plotly charts

files.name: tests/test_app.py
files.purpose: Unit tests for Flask routes and API endpoints

acceptance_criteria: Server starts and binds to configured port (default 5000)
GET /api/data returns JSON with status 200 and valid data structure
All unit tests in tests/ pass with 100% coverage
assumptions_made: Assumed project type: interactive web dashboard
Assumed stack: Python Flask with HTML5 UI
